shots.h3_prompt: The four characters march toward the camera in single file with a clear gap between each of them, never touching or stepping onto each other, while the paper keeps unrolling toward the camera until the very end. The plain paper roll keeps unrolling slowly toward the floor, its curled top end turning. The alum, the baby-oil and both oil bottles march along it one after another, the alum scowling, the baby-oil hurrying nervously, all with closed mouths. To the end they keep marching in step, bobbing, blinking and swinging their arms, while the paper keeps creeping forward. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.rr_why: The paper rolls back up and recedes into the room instead of unrolling forward. From ~2.2 s the marchers bunch up: the two oil bottles stack into a totem, one standing on the other's cap, and the baby-oil overlaps the alum (looks merged). Only 0.4-2.0 s is clean, against a 4.41 s VO.

The laser machine rolls forward a little and stops. Its screen face talks coldly with clear, natural mouth movement on every word (0-4 s), the blue light on its front pulsing. Then it closes its mouth, blinks slowly and stares flatly, rocking slightly on its wheels, the blue light pulsing calmly until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects, no people. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.rr_why: Talking shot whose mouth moves only ~2.2-4.0 s. From 0.4 to 2.1 s the machine rolls well forward and turns with a closed smile, and from 4.1 s it stares with a closed frown (idle tail, idle_from 4.6). That is about 1.8 s of speech for a 5.51 s line. Its cute face also turns stern.
